text:
Sasha K.: alerting — we're seeing a sustained token-store 5xx rate after the midnight deploy, ~30% of requests failing p50->p95 error gap. PagerBot: :rotating_light: INC-4921 paged to eng-oncall, severity P1.
Jordan L.: on it. quick check — is this the eviction-related surge we saw last week? any customer errors reported yet?
Sasha K.: early signals from prod-telemetry: increased eviction churn on hostpool-a (eu-west-1), KV miss rate + cache thrash, tail latencies spike. Affected customers: a few mid-market tenants on Dedicated with heavy long-context workloads. Support flagged 2 customers seeing retries.
Lee M.: I'm primary for the shift. I'll take triage and mitigations. Sasha — can you paste the runbook section you used before?
Sasha K.: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tokenstore-eviction — follow "eviction-throttle-mitigation" steps. TL;DR: 1) reduce eviction aggressiveness, 2) pin hot prefixes to local cache, 3) roll back latest inference runtime patch if needed.
OpsBot: latest deploy 2026-03-15T00:10 by ci/cd (build 7f3a2). Rollout 100% to eu-west-1.
Jordan L.: ok scope: hosts with eviction rate > 10/s. I'll open a simple query to list top offenders.
Ben R.: FYI support: customers are retrying, no major data loss. CS assigned case #CS-988. We should provide ETA in 30m.
Lee M.: immediate mitigation plan:
- Step A: throttle eviction controller on pool `tokenstore-eu-a` to 30% (safe param)
- Step B: enable prefix pinning for top-10 prefixes for 1 hour
- Step C: if no improvement in 10m, revert runtime build to 7f2b9
Sasha K.: commands:
```
# reduce eviction aggressiveness
kubectl -n redwood set env deploy/eviction-controller EVICT_RATE=0.3 --record
# enable pinning
redwood-admin cache pin --pool tokenstore-eu-a --prefixes $(cat /tmp/top-prefixes.txt)
```
Jordan L.: running the query to gather top prefixes now.
OpsBot: action started: set env on eviction-controller
Sasha K.: I'll prepare the revert PR just in case. tagging it `revert/runtime-7f3a2`.
Lee M.: Jordan — once you have the top prefixes, push them to /tmp/top-prefixes.txt on ops-runner node-3 and execute Sasha's pin command. I'll watch metrics.
Jordan L.: query done — top prefixes heavy: [user-vec, session-cache, instr-output, chat-cache] — pushing to ops-runner.
Jordan L.: pushed and executed pin command. waiting for cache warmup.
OpsBot: metrics: eviction-rate down 45% on tokenstore-eu-a after pinning. tail latency p99 dropped from 420ms -> 220ms.
Ben R.: telling CS: initial mitigation successful, asking customers to hold for 30m for stabilization. CS-988 updated.
Lee M.: good. next steps: keep pinned for 60m, monitor eviction-rate and error-rate. If error-rate < 2% and p99 < 300ms, keep patch live and close in 1h. If not, we revert.
Sasha K.: logging action items in incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-4921
Jordan L.: note: there is a secondary hostpool `tokenstore-eu-b` with similar pattern but lower amplitude. Will pre-stage pins there in case of spillover.
OpsBot: scheduled job: pre-stage pins on tokenstore-eu-b in 10m.
Lee M.: handoff notes for next shift (primary -> secondary):
- Primary now: Lee M. (taking over until 06:30 UTC)
- Secondary: Jordan L.
- Active alerts: INC-4921 (token-store eviction surge), PagerBot active, alert group: tokenstore-p99, eviction-rate-high
- Mitigations in progress: eviction throttle at 30%, top-10 prefix pinning applied to tokenstore-eu-a, pre-stage on tokenstore-eu-b
- Customer impact: limited retries for 2 mid-market customers, no data loss, CS case CS-988
- Runbook pointers: tokenstore-eviction runbook (eviction-throttle-mitigation), rollback runtime steps in runbook
- Escalation path: if error-rate > 5% after 20m, escalate to EngSRE lead (oncall-lead@redwood)
- Docs/links: incident doc, runbook, support case link
Sasha K.: adding note: observed correlation with large batched requests at 00:05 UTC. We should consider rate limiting those flows as medium-term fix.
Lee M.: any outstanding actions for the next on-call?
Jordan L.: monitor for 30m, pre-stage pins on pool-b finished, will also watch memory footprint growth on eviction-controller pods.
Ben R.: CS will ping if customers see regressions, I'll keep channel updated.
PagerBot: :white_check_mark: Incident status: Mitigated -> Ongoing(stable). No immediate pageres.
Lee M.: handing off now. If anything regresses, page both Jordan and me. I'll be reachable on phone if escalated. :phone:
Sasha K.: thx team. I'll follow up with a short postmortem draft after stabilization. :thumbsup:
Jordan L.: copying notes to shift log. Good handoff.
Ben R.: thanks — closing support loop if stable in 1h.
OpsBot: note: remember to rotate the pin list after 1h to avoid state divergence.
Lee M.: last message before stepping out: objectives for next 60m: ensure error-rate < 2%, p99 < 300ms, no new customers impacted. If met, we'll transition to monitoring-only and close incident in incident tracker.
Sasha K.: acknowledged.
